summary.tagline: Iconic chalk cliffs overlooking the English Channel within the South Downs National Park.
summary.best_season: Spring and summer offer the clearest views and better conditions for coastal walking.
summary.seo_title: Visiting Beachy Head: Chalk Cliffs and South Downs Way

travel.headline: Public Access Cliffs and South Downs Way Entry
travel.reservation: Access to the cliff tops is generally open to the public without a gated entry fee. Visitors should check the official Visit Eastbourne portal for any local event closures or specific site notices before traveling to the South Downs area.

days.title: Chalk Cliffs and Coastal Vistas

stops.name: Beachy Head
stops.detail: Experience the spectacular cliff tops and walk up from Meads village to view the iconic white chalk formations.

days.driving: Allow time for local transfers or walking; conditions vary based on weather.
days.note: Stay well away from the cliff edges and follow all posted safety signs for your protection.

intel.title: Pedestrian and Cycle Access
intel.text: Visitors can reach the cliffs by walking from the western end of the Eastbourne seafront at Meads village. Alternatively, cycling is possible from the start of the South Downs Way.

intel.title: Seafront Approach
intel.text: The climb from Eastbourne requires steady pacing; allow for varying weather conditions on the exposed cliff tops. Evidence does not specify exact opening hours for the open landscape.

intel.title: Local Services Gap
intel.text: Specific fuel stations and local amenity locations are not listed in the official park source. Travelers should secure supplies in Eastbourne before heading to the cliff tops.

intel.title: Emergency Contact
intel.text: Network reliability is not documented; however, in an emergency, visitors are instructed to call 999 and ask for the Coastguard. Do not rely on mobile data for navigation near the edge.

intel.title: Local Parking Availability
intel.text: Specific parking lot locations and capacity are not detailed in the source packet. Visitors should verify parking facilities in Meads village or Eastbourne before arrival.

plan.arrival: Arrive in Eastbourne to collect any supplies before heading to the western end of the seafront at Meads village to begin the ascent.
plan.vehicle: Suitable for standard cars; check for any local weight or width restrictions on narrow coastal roads.
plan.goldenHour: The chalk cliffs face the sea, offering dramatic light at sunset, though cliff stability and visibility must be checked locally.
